readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_verify_evidence.py reads FAIL verdicts back to the pull request's creation, capped at TOO_OLD_DAYS (80), and PASS verdicts at the current head
.github/scripts/pr-merge/carry-run-cache.mjs RETENTION_DAYS (90) bounds the verdict runs it carries
.github/workflows/pr-require-checks.yml ci-status reads the PASS verdict at the head
scripts/credential-sweep.sh --since defaults to 90 days ago, GitHub's default artifact retention
pr-verify-*.reason: A FAIL verdict must outlive the 80-day FAIL look-back (babysit_verify_evidence.py TOO_OLD_DAYS = 80, ten days under 90): a shorter retention drops earlier FAILs, and the gate then stops refusing verify:earlier-fail and the FAIL cap. scripts/credential-sweep.sh also assumes 90-day artifacts. write-verdict.mjs retentionDays keeps FAIL at max, a PASS or PASS-NOTES judged after a body edit or issue link change since the head commit at max too (it may supersede a FAIL there, which the gate reads at later heads of the same change), and any other PASS or PASS-NOTES 7 days: it is read only at the open pull request's current head, and an expired one fails closed as verify:missing until the next pr-require-checks run (push, edit or label) has pr-verify judge the head again. The row records the longest.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_review_evidence.py _main_bound binds a lane-source pull request's lanes on these verdicts and counts the most findings any of them reported for the head's tree
pr-review-main-*.reason: A verdict that reported findings must outlive a later clean review of the same tree, or its expiry would lower the count the gate reads; the gate counts the most findings any unexpired verdict of the tree reported.
pr-review-main-*.pending-cut: About 238 a day, 21,400 at 90 days. CRITICAL counts already carry on the record job's check runs (babysit_merge.py carried_critical), but the below-CRITICAL total security_review_clean reads does not; a short window needs that total read from the check runs first.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py _Context.lane_dispatched (LANE_DISPATCH_ARTIFACT) reads the record of each dispatch run covering a lane merge, on every check, back to merged_since with no cursor; the run listing it reads from stops at RUN_SEARCH_CAP
plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py _lane_reruns reads records of runs created within confirm-wait-minutes plus FULL_RUN_ALLOWANCE
.github/scripts/pr-merge/lane-records.mjs carries the records the post-merge check proved, each only until its artifact's expires_at, so the carry adds no lifetime
pr-merge-dispatched-*.reason: The look-back is merged_since, the later of the enabling commit and the newest demotion clear, with no bound in days. It stops at the post-merge check's 1000-run listing cap (babysit_gh.py RUN_SEARCH_CAP): past that the check is unreadable and holds the lane whatever this row says. At the 48 and 57 dispatch runs in the two days to 2026-10-31T05:00Z, after the 30-minute cap and its bypass landed, that is about 19 days, and demotion clears had come at most 4.8 days apart; 30 days leaves about 11 more for a stopped check, whose runs then accumulate only at the human merge rate. This holds while the listing reaches 1000 runs, or a clear moves the floor, within 30 days: at least 34 runs a day. A record that has left the listing never verifies a merge: its run stops counting as the lane's, so the merge holds as an unlisted record until a later recorded run covers it, and a flaked or in-between red run can read red and demote.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py LANE_RERUN_ARTIFACT, read back to merged_since, and only while the run's pr-merge-dispatched record exists (lane_rerun)
.github/scripts/pr-merge/lane-records.mjs keeps the records the post-merge check proved
pr-merge-rerun-*.reason: The post-merge check reads the lane's re-run record back to merged_since, only while the run's pr-merge-dispatched record exists; keep this at or above that family's days.

readers: plugins/source-control/skills/babysit-prs/scripts/babysit_postmerge.py LANE_ALERT_ARTIFACT (`--lane-alerted`), asked by .github/workflows/pr-merge.yml post-merge-dispatch only for full runs created within LOOKBACK_HOURS (6)
